visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit retail store. Two mannequins, one male and one female, are positioned in the foreground wearing tight-fitting thermal tops in dark grey and purple. The background is filled with various clothing racks and promotional signage in Japanese. (2) The scene shifts to close-up shots of clothing racks at Ito-Yokado, showcasing 'Seven Premium' thermal shirts in colors like beige, grey, and lavender. A person's hand enters the frame to highlight a packaged thermal top with red and white branding. (3) The camera pans to the interior of an 'N+' (Nitori) store, featuring a 'SALE MAX 50%' sign. Stacks of dark-colored trousers are displayed on a wooden table. A hand picks up a pair of black down-filled pants to show a pink tag with a duck illustration and technical details. (4) The scene transitions to a 'tutuanna' store specializing in socks. The interior is warm with soft lighting. Displays feature numerous pairs of socks and thermal leggings. A hand demonstrates the thick, black fleece lining of a pair of tights and points to various lace-trimmed thermal shirt styles on a promotional board. Close-up shots show fuzzy grey and white socks with non-slip dots on the soles. (5) The video concludes with a static graphic on a white background featuring a pink 'japanuts' logo and social media contact information.
